output.subject: We've received your complaint about the charges from Coastline Auto Body
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us about the charges on your credit card. We have received your complaint and want to confirm what you told us.

You mentioned that Coastline Auto Body charged your credit card twice for the same visit on August 27, with two charges of $1,260.00 appearing a few minutes apart. You told us that when you contacted the merchant, they said they could see only one charge on their end and suggested you call your bank. You have asked for the duplicate charge to be removed.

We understand how worrying it is to see an unexpected charge of this size, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused, especially after you had already reached out to the merchant.

We are looking into the concerns you have raised, and a specialist team is reviewing your complaint. We will respond to you within 10 business days. If you have a receipt or any other details from your visit that you would like to share, please feel free to reply to this message.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The reply still says a specialist team is reviewing the complaint, without naming the team, because acknowledge-only replies must say this. Delete that clause if you would rather the reply mention no team.
Check whether both $1,260.00 transactions posted or whether one is a pending authorization that may drop off.
Decide whether a dispute or chargeback should be opened and whether any provisional credit applies. The reply promises neither.
Confirm the card the customer referenced matches the account on file. The card number is not included in the reply.
Confirm the year of the August 27 transactions, since the customer did not state it.
Decide whether to keep the invitation to send a receipt or replace it with specific documentation requests.
